description.content:
Returns the MetaLend AI Agent Flow Guide — a comprehensive reference for AI agents covering authentication flows, signing formats, config wizard, deposit/withdrawal patterns, and known failure modes. **AI agents must fetch this document before implementing any MetaLend operation.

The guide is returned as `text/markdown` and is rate limited to 20 requests per 60 seconds per IP.

info.name: MetaLend Rebalancing AI Agent Guide API

description.content:
API for managing cross-protocol cross-chain DeFi rebalancing operations exposing:
  • Auth – challenge/verify flow for JWT issuance.
  • Project settings – fetch current project settings.
  • User configuration – register or update token-level user-rebalancer settings and fetch current wallet configs.
  • Deposits – create deposit intents, receive tracking IDs, and poll status through PROCESSING -> BRIDGING (cross-chain only) -> SUCCESS/FAILED/EMERGENCY_WITHDRAW. New deposits may return 503 with DEPOSITS_PAUSED during maintenance.
  • Withdrawals – submit signed withdrawal requests, receive tracking IDs, and monitor status PROCESSING -> SUCCESS/FAILED.
  • Balances – query wallet-level balances and withdraw details, as well as balances in bridge progress.
  • Rewards – aggregated rewards and claim details per wallet.
  • Pools – list supported protocols (Aave, Morpho, Euler, etc.), their pools, APY breakdowns, and TVL snapshots.
  • Transaction Costs – current deposit/withdraw on-behalf transaction fees and minimum amounts by chain.
  • AI Agent Guide – Markdown flow guide at /SKILL.md with signing formats, wizard requirements, and known integration gotchas.
All endpoints require an X-API-Key. JWT authentication is required on deposit, withdrawal, and config update operations. Obtain API key by creating a new project. All requests must include the Origin header. Use Origin: https://app.metalend.tech unless you have been assigned a different allowed origin. Contact Support: Name: MetaLend API Support Email: support@metalend.tech
